overview.title: Observer delivery: one publisher, registered listeners

edges.label: only if listener is still alive

overview.explanation: The call arrows show one listener delivery, repeated in registration order. A successful weak lock creates temporary shared ownership; it is not an inheritance relationship. Expired entries produce no call. The scope guard covers the whole publication and clears the flag if this call throws.

focus.title: Hold each listener through its callback
focus.start: // Clear the flag on every exit.
focus.what: This guarded loop delivers values only to live listeners.
focus.where: It follows range checking and rejection of a nested publication.
focus.why: Temporary shared ownership keeps a listener alive during its own update call.
focus.invariant: The registration vector stays unchanged and the flag is cleared on every exit.
focus.risk: A callback can throw after partial delivery; this loop does not undo prior listener effects.

focus.title: A listener may have effects before it throws

focus.why: The hook makes reentrancy and exception policies observable in deterministic tests.

focus.risk: An exception from after happens after sum changes; delivery is not rolled back.
